source.notes: 1,000,000 synthetic SimpleFeatures (2 to 6 bp each, an integer score) through runTransforms and then the native encode of what the steps answered (y, a constant colour, no index), seven arms interleaved round-robin in one node 24 process, min of 7 rounds, load average under 2. A row is the steps plus the encode of their output, per input feature. 'none' is the encode alone over the raw list; 'filter' is one jexl filter keeping every other feature; 'formula' is one jexl formula writing a field the encode then reads; 'bin-count' bins at 10 kb and counts per bin, so the encode walks 300 bins in place of a million features; 'bin-mean' adds a mean score per bin; 'coverage' is the sweep over the spans, 1.6 runs per input feature here; 'bin-then-raw' is the bin-count layer and the raw layer over one fetched list, what a multiscale config costs the worker per region. The aggregate keyed its groups by raw field values through one Map per groupby field after a string key per feature measured 2.5x that; aggregate and coverage outputs are a plain data-backed feature with a lazy id after a SimpleFeature per output measured 1.9x that. The jexl arms cost what the jexl channel does (mark-encoding-jexl-channel). 'vs none' is typed rather than derived because it divides by another row.
